name: bluesky-post
notes:
Modelled on bsky.app as of 2026-09; not run against live Bluesky. /intent/compose opens the composer dialog over the home feed (the URL becomes /). signedIn: the left nav's Profile link (aria-label Profile, href /profile/), rendered only when logged in. Post text: the composer's TipTap/ProseMirror contenteditable (.ProseMirror inside [role=dialog]; one

per line). submit: the composer's Post button (data-testid composerPublishBtn). receipt: the 'Your post has been published' toast (role=alert) and its View link to /profile//post/.
